findings.source_quote: Some of his deepest struggles stemmed from the flashback memories he had of when he had personally killed several of the enemy.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “ricordi vividi” with “flashback” or “ricordi intrusivi e ricorrenti” to retain the sense of flashback memories.
findings.translation_quote: Alcune delle sue lotte più profonde derivavano dai ricordi vividi di quando aveva ucciso personalmente diversi nemici.
